change: neutralize player-specific hitter and pitcher I1 event rates while preserving the player-as-of batting-order/state engine

primary_evidence.interpretation: player-specific I1 hitter/pitcher event-rate layers add no measurable full-I2 predictive value; neutralization is slightly better in both development and replication but the magnitude is negligible

monte_carlo_replay_role.reason: The exact deterministic development log-loss difference is approximately 5.2e-7, far below the season-level variation observed in prior 10k replay comparisons. A 10k Monte Carlo sign is therefore not an appropriate selector for this simplification.

decision.rationale: Remove a complexity layer that contributes no measurable target-level information while retaining the actual I1 lineup/state mechanism.

next_gate: Evaluate the combined lean candidate after the standalone direct-I2 platoon decision is resolved; do not promote piecemeal.
